title: Area 51 confirmed under the Obama administration
summary: Joe Rogan tells of Area 51 confirmed under the Obama administration, about 2009-2017 at Nevada test site and Area 51, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: It actually wasn't even confirmed until the Obama administration cuz the Obama administration, they wanted to expand the barriers for entry

plain: Joe Rogan, a well-known podcast host, says on Jesse Michels's show that Area 51, a secret US military base in the Nevada desert long tied to UFO stories, was not officially admitted to exist until the Obama administration, sometime between 2009 and 2017. According to Rogan, that happened because the government wanted to widen the restricted zone around the site. He tells it to show how long the government kept even the base's existence quiet.
